question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The teacher ______ with laughter, pleased with his joke, but then composed himself.
solution:
The correct answer is **"****brayed."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "brayed" **means to speak or laugh loudly and harshly. (जोर से और कठोरता से बोलना या हंसना)

 
 
• **Example**: *He **brayed**__ with laughter.*
 
 
 
• *​*The word** "brayed"** is the most suitable choice for the blank in the given sentence.
 
• 
 
Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

 

**Correct sentence:* ****The teacher __**brayed**__ with laughter, pleased with his joke, but then composed himself.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let us explore other options:
 
 
• **Blade: **the flat, sharp part of a knife, etc. (चाक़ू आदि का चपटा तेज़ धार वाला फ़लक; ब्‍लेड, धार)
 
• **Braid: **thin coloured rope that is used to decorate military uniforms, etc. (सैनिक पोशाकों में प्रयुक्त सजावटी फ़ीता)
 
• **Bread: **a type of food made from flour and water mixed together and baked in an oven. Yeast is usually added to make the bread rise. (डबलरोटी, ब्रेड)
